name: Nomad Flagship
desc:
Anchors a migrant population, the Flotilla, that lives aboard your ships. The Flotilla assembles over a few days.

Reduces cargo capacity by %s and maximum crew by %s, and raises monthly supply upkeep by %s.

Other ships add their Space and Berths to the Flotilla only while they travel in the same fleet as the flagship. Only one Nomad Flagship may exist. Can not be installed on ships smaller than a destroyer.
short: Anchors a migrant population aboard your ships.

name: Nomad Fleet Member
desc: Reduces the ship's cargo capacity by %s and maximum crew by %s. The freed cargo capacity becomes Flotilla Space and the freed quarters become Berths. Raises monthly supply upkeep by %s.
short: Gives part of the ship's hold and quarters to the Flotilla.

name: Nomad Cargo Conversion
desc: Gives the ship's entire hold to the Flotilla as Space, and reduces maximum crew by %s. Raises monthly supply upkeep by %s.
short: Gives the ship's whole hold to the Flotilla.

name: Nomad Quarters Conversion
desc: Reduces the ship's crew to the minimum required. Also reduces cargo capacity by %s. Raises monthly supply upkeep by %s.
short: Converts the ship's crew space to Berths.

name: Nomad Full Conversion
desc: Gives the ship's entire hold to the Flotilla as Space and reduces its crew to the minimum required. Raises monthly supply upkeep by %s.
short: Gives the ship's whole hold and quarters to the Flotilla.
